entries.source: SPEAK UP, HAMBRAIN. I'VE JUST GOTTEN MY EARDRUMS BLOWN OUT BY YET ANOTHER BY-THE-PYRE POTION GONE SOUTH, REMEMBER? THRICE-DAMNED THING WAS GOING PERFECTLY, TOO. TOKNOR'S TACKLE!
entries.target: 说大声点，笨蛋！我的耳膜刚又被一瓶该死的药剂炸破了，记得吗？那该死的东西本来一切顺利！图库纳的命根子！

entries.source: [Indicate the %s.]
entries.target: [指向 %s。]

entries.source: WHICH ELIXIR DO YOU WANT TO HELP ME WITH? YOU ARE HERE TO DO JUST THAT, RIGHT? YOU'RE NOT SOME IMBECILE HERE LOOKING FOR A LOVE POTION?
entries.target: 你想帮我配哪一种药剂？你是来帮忙的吧？你该不会是来求迷情药水的蠢货吧？

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A tall woman stands before you. Her fair skin radiates incredible power through her white robe.*#WHITE#
I am Linaniil of the Kar'Krul. Welcome to our city, @playerdescriptor.subclass@. What may I do for thee?
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一名身材高大的女子伫立在你面前。她白皙的肌肤透过白袍散发着惊人的力量。*#WHITE#
我是卡·克鲁尔的莱娜尼尔。欢迎来到我们的城市，@playerdescriptor.subclass@。我能为你做些什么？

entries.source: I require all the help I can get, not for my sake but for the town of Derth, to the northeast of here.
entries.target: 我需要能得到的所有帮助，不是为了我自己，而是为了此地东北方的德斯镇。

entries.source: I am ready! Send me to Urkis!
entries.target: 我准备好了！送我去厄奇斯那里！

entries.source: Urkis has been slain.
entries.target: 厄奇斯已被诛杀。

entries.source: Nothing for now. Sorry to have taken your time. Farewell, my lady.
entries.target: 暂时无事。抱歉耽误了您的时间。告辞，女士。

entries.source:
Yes, we have noticed the devastation that happened there. I have sent some friends thence to disperse the cloud, but the true threat lies not there.
He who created this abomination is Urkis. He is a Tempest, a powerful Archmage who channels the storms.
Years ago he went rogue, severing himself from Angolwen. At first he remained quiet, and thus we withheld action, but it seems we have no choice now.
Cleansing the skies will take much time. In the meanwhile, if thou art willing, we can send thee to Urkis' lair to face him.
I will not lie to thee: we can send thee thence, but this could be a death trap, and we have no means for thou to depart his lair, as he lives atop a tall peak in the Daikara mountains.
entries.target:
是的，我们已经注意到了那里所遭受的破坏。我已派了几位同伴前往该处驱散阴云，但真正的威胁并不在那里。
造就这桩灾祸的是厄奇斯。他是一名风暴法师，一位能够引导风暴的强大元素法师。
数年前他背离正道，断绝了与安格利文的联系。起初他一直保持沉寂，因此我们未予干预，但如今看来我们已别无选择。
净化天空需要耗费诸多时日。在此期间，若你愿意，我们可将你送往厄奇斯的巢穴，由你亲自直面他。
我不会对你有所隐瞒：我们固然能将你送去那里，但这可能是一处死亡陷阱；并且由于他隐居在岱卡拉山脉的高峰之巅，我们无法将你从他的巢穴中接引离开。

entries.source: I need to prepare myself. I will be back soon.
entries.target: 我需要先做些准备。我很快就会回来。

entries.source: I am ready. Send me. I will not let the good people of Derth down.
entries.target: 我准备好了。送我过去吧。我不会辜负德斯镇善良的居民。

entries.source: Good luck to thee. Thou hast the blessings of Angolwen.
entries.target: 祝你好运。安格利文的祝福与你同在。

entries.source: Thank you.
entries.target: 谢谢。

entries.source: I see the storm is calmed.  Take this rune as a token of my appreciation.
entries.target: 我见风暴已经平息。请收下这枚符文，作为我的谢礼。

entries.source: Welcome @playername@ to my shop.
entries.target: @playername@，欢迎来到我的商店。

entries.source: Let me see your wares.
entries.target: 让我看看你的商品吧。

entries.source: I am looking for staff training.
entries.target: 我想寻求法杖战斗训练。

entries.source: Sorry, I have to go!
entries.target: 抱歉，我得走了！

entries.source: I can teach you staff combat (talent category Spell/Staff combat).  Learning the basics costs 100 gold, while more intensive tutelage to gain proficiency costs 500 gold.  Once you're proficient, I can teach you more refined techniques for an additional 750 gold.
entries.target: 我可以传授你法杖格斗技巧（技能类别：法术/法杖格斗）。学习基础需要 100 金币，而要接受更深入的指导、达到熟练掌握，则需 500 金币。一旦你达到熟练，再额外支付 750 金币，我便能传授你更精湛的技巧。

entries.source: Just give me the basics (reveals locked talent category) - 100 gold.
entries.target: 只学习基础（揭示锁定的技能树）- 100 金币。

entries.source: The staff carver spends some time with you, teaching you the basics of staff combat.
entries.target: 制杖师花了一些时间指导你，向你传授法杖格斗的基础技巧。

entries.source: He is surprised at how quickly you are able to follow his tutelage.
entries.target: 他对你能如此迅速领会他的指导感到惊讶。

entries.source: Please teach me what I need to know (unlocks talent category) - %d gold.
entries.target: 请传授我所需知晓的一切（解锁技能类别）- %d 金币。

entries.source: The staff carver spends a substantial amount of time teaching you all of the techniques of staff combat.
entries.target: 制杖师花了大量时间指导你，向你传授法杖格斗的全部技巧。

entries.source: He is impressed with your mastery and shows you a few extra techniques.
entries.target: 他对你的熟练程度印象深刻，并向你展示了一些额外技巧。

entries.source: I'm already proficient, but I want to be an expert (improves talent mastery by 0.2) - 750 gold.
entries.target: 我已经熟练掌握了，但我想成为一名专家。（增加技能树系数0.2）- 750 金币。

entries.source: The staff carver spends a great deal of time going over the finer details of staff combat with you%s.
entries.target: 制杖师花了大量时间与你一同推敲法杖格斗的精妙细节%s。

entries.source: , including some esoteric techniques
entries.target: ，包括一些秘传技巧

entries.source: No thanks.
entries.target: 不用了，谢谢。

entries.source: #{italic}##LIGHT_GREEN#*As you drink the potion, your runes start to burn as they fade away, and a terrible agony seems to sink through your skin to your bones, muscles, and heart.  You black out from the pain, and come to a bit later, the runes gone forever.  You feel very ill, and yet...  cleansed.*#{normal}##WHITE#
entries.target: #{italic}##LIGHT_GREEN#*当你饮下药剂，身上的符文在逐渐消逝时灼烧起来，一股可怕的剧痛仿佛穿透你的肌肤，深嵌进骨骼、肌肉与心脏。你在剧痛中昏厥过去，稍后苏醒时，符文已永远消失。你感到极度虚弱不适，然而……却又感到被洗涤净化。*#{normal}##WHITE#

entries.source:
Excellent! You truly prove that no mage-wrought flame or storm can stand against blade and arrow! Come, learn our ways. You are ready.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*he gives you a potion.*#WHITE#
Drink this. We extract it from a very rare kind of drake. It will grant you powers to fight and cancel magic, but never again will you be able to use magic.%s
entries.target:
干得漂亮！你切实证明了，任何法师造就的烈焰或风暴都敌不过刀剑与利箭！来吧，学习我们的技艺。你已经做好了准备。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他递给你一瓶药剂。*#WHITE#
喝下它。这是我们从一种极为罕见的龙类身上提取而成的。它将赋予你对抗并消除魔法的力量，但自此之后你将再也无法使用魔法。%s

entries.source: Thank you. I shall not let magic triumph! #LIGHT_GREEN#[you drink the potion]
entries.target: 多谢。我绝不会让魔法得逞！#LIGHT_GREEN#[你喝下了药剂]

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*As the monstrous spider falls you see something... moving in her belly until it explodes! A tall black man steps out of the spewed guts, surrounded by a golden light.*#WHITE#
By the Sun! I thought I would never again see a friendly face!
Thank you. I am Rashim, and I am in your debt.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*随着那只巨蛛轰然倒下，你看到有什么东西……在它的腹部蠕动，直到猛然炸开！一名高大的黑肤男子从喷溅的内脏中迈步走出，周身环绕着金色光芒。*#WHITE#
太阳在上！我原以为自己再也见不到一张友善的面孔了！
多谢你。我是拉希姆，我欠你一份恩情。

entries.source: I have been sent by your wife. She was worried for you.
entries.target: 我是受你妻子之托而来的。她非常担心你的安危。

entries.source:
Ah, my dear heart!
Well, now that I am free I will create a portal to the Gates of Morning. I think I've seen enough spiders for the rest of my life.
entries.target:
啊，我亲爱的心上人！
好了，既然现在我已脱困，我这就开启一道通往晨曦之门的传送门。我想我这辈子见过的蜘蛛已经足够多了。

entries.source: Lead the way!
entries.target: 请带路吧！

entries.source: Good day to you.
entries.target: 祝你日安。

entries.source: Good day to you too.
entries.target: 也祝你日安。

entries.source: I have heard you are a great hero of the west. Could you help me, please?
entries.target: 我听说你是来自西方的伟大英雄。能否请你帮帮我？

entries.source: Maybe, what is it about?
entries.target: 也许可以，所为何事？

entries.source: I have got enough problems sorry.
entries.target: 我自己的麻烦已经够多了，抱歉。

entries.source: Welcome back, @playername@.
entries.target: 欢迎回来，@playername@。

entries.source: I have found your husband. I take it he made it home safely?
entries.target: 我找到你的丈夫了。想必他已经安全到家了吧？

entries.source: I've got to go. Bye.
entries.target: 我得走了。再见。

entries.source:
My husband, Rashim, is a Sun Paladin. He was sent to clear the spider lair of Ardhungol to the north of this town.
It has been three days now. He should be back by now. I have a feeling something terrible has happened to him. Please find him!
He should have a magical stone given by the Anorithil to create a portal back here, yet he did not use it!
entries.target:
我的丈夫拉希姆是一名太阳骑士。他被派去清理本镇北方的阿尔德胡格蜘蛛巢穴。
如今已经过去三天了。按理说他现在早该回来了。我有一种不祥的预感，他一定是遭遇了可怕的不测。求求你帮我找到他！
他身上本该携带着星月术士所赠的魔法石，用来开启返回此地的传送门，可他却一直没有使用！

entries.source: I will see if I can find him.
entries.target: 我去看看能否找到他。

entries.source: Spiders? Eww, sorry, but he is probably dead now.
entries.target: 蜘蛛？恶……抱歉，但他现在恐怕凶多吉少了。

entries.source: Yes, yes he did! He said he would have died if not for you.
entries.target: 是的，他确实平安回来了！他说若不是有你相救，他早就没命了。

entries.source: It was nothing.
entries.target: 举手之劳而已。

entries.source: Gladiator's wares
entries.target: 角斗士商店

entries.source: None
entries.target: 无

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#You take a look at the ranking boards before entering.
%s
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#进入竞技场前，你查看了一下排名榜。
%s

entries.source: Enter the arena (60 waves)
entries.target: 进入竞技场（60 波）

entries.source: Enter the arena (shorter mode, 30 rounds)
entries.target: 进入竞技场（较短模式，30 波）

entries.source: #LIGHT_RED#[Reset all arena save data]
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#[重置所有竞技场存档数据]

entries.source: Enter the arena for 60 rounds
entries.target: 进入竞技场，进行 60 波

entries.source: Enter the arena for 30 rounds
entries.target: 进入竞技场，进行 30 波

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A tall, hooded man stares at you*#WHITE#
Yes...yes...you look like a promising warrior indeed...
I have an offer, @playerdescriptor.race@.
You see...I am an agent for the Arena. I look for promising warriors that
can provide a good show for our audience. Perhaps you are strong enough to join.
All you need to do is beat three of my men in battle, and you shall be rewarded.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You consider the offer of the mysterious hooded man for a moment*
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个高大、头戴兜帽的男人注视着你*#WHITE#
是的……是的……你的确像是一名很有潜力的战士……
我有个提议，@playerdescriptor.race@。
你看……我是竞技场的招募员，专门寻找能为观众献上精彩表演的潜力战士。或许你足够强大，能够加入我们。
你只需在战斗中击败我的三名手下，就能获得奖励。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你思量了片刻这个神秘兜帽人的提议*

entries.source: Interesting. Tell me more about that Arena.
entries.target: 有意思。多说说竞技场吧。

entries.source: I am strong! What do you have to offer?
entries.target: 我很强！你能给我什么？

entries.source: I don't accept deals from shady hooded men.
entries.target: 我不和鬼鬼祟祟的兜帽人做交易。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You can feel the man smiling from inside his hood*#WHITE#
I have wealth and glory to offer, and some very useful
#YELLOW#combat experience#WHITE# from fighting our men...
So, what do you think? Are you up to it?
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你能感觉到兜帽下的男人露出了微笑*#WHITE#
我能给你财富和荣耀，而与我的手下交战，还能让你获得一些十分有用的
#YELLOW#战斗经验#WHITE#……
怎么样？你能胜任吗？

entries.source: I am ready for battle. Let's go!
entries.target: 我已准备好战斗。走吧！

entries.source: I don't have time for games, Cornac.
entries.target: 我没空陪你玩游戏，科纳克人。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You can feel the man smiling from inside his hood*#WHITE#
The Arena is where the brave come to fight against all odds.
We are still growing up, and we lack challengers...
It's like a gamble, but you use your fighting instead of money to play, you see?
We in the Arena work hard to make a good show, and in return...you can get enough
wealth and glory to last for centuries!
If you can pass my little test...I will #LIGHT_RED#allow you to join the Arena when
you are done with your adventures.#WHITE#
You also shall gather some much needed #LIGHT_RED#combat experience#WHITE# from fighting
our men...so, what do you think? Are you up to it?
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你能感觉到兜帽下的男人露出了微笑*#WHITE#
竞技场是勇者迎战重重险境的地方。
我们仍在发展，正缺少挑战者……
这就像一场赌博，只不过你下注的不是金钱，而是自己的战斗本领，明白吗？
我们竞技场竭力奉上精彩表演；作为回报……
你能赢得足以让你受用几个世纪的财富与荣耀！
如果你能通过我的小小考验……
等你的冒险结束后，我会#LIGHT_RED#准许你加入竞技场。#WHITE#
与我的手下交战，还能让你获得急需的#LIGHT_RED#战斗经验#WHITE#……
怎么样？你能胜任吗？

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The man lets out a disappointed sigh*#WHITE#
That's unfortunate. We could have used someone like you.
You are just the type the audience likes. You could have been a champion.
Alas, if you stand by your choice, we shall never meet again.
However, if you change your mind...I will #YELLOW#stay in Derth just a little
longer.#WHITE#
If I am still around, we can have a deal. Think about it, @playerdescriptor.race@.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*男人失望地叹了口气*#WHITE#
真遗憾。我们本可以用上你这样的人。
你正是观众喜欢的类型，本可以成为一名冠军。
唉，如果你坚持这个选择，我们就再也不会见面了。
不过，如果你改变主意……我还会#YELLOW#在德斯镇多待一小段时间。#WHITE#
只要我还在，我们就仍可谈成这笔交易。好好想想吧，@playerdescriptor.race@。

entries.source: We'll see. [Leave]
entries.target: 再说吧。[离开]

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The man smiles in approval*#WHITE#
Excellent! A great fighter is always willing to head into battle.
You certainly won't regret meeting us, indeed...
So, are you ready to fight?
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*男人赞许地微笑起来*#WHITE#
好极了！伟大的斗士总是愿意投身战斗。
遇见我们，你肯定不会后悔……真的。
那么，你准备好战斗了吗？

entries.source: Sounds like fun. I'm ready!
entries.target: 听起来很有趣。我准备好了！

entries.source: Wait. I am not ready yet.
entries.target: 等一下，我还没准备好。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*The man quietly walks away, after making you a gesture to follow him*
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*男人示意你跟上，随后默默走开*

entries.source: [Follow him]
entries.target: [跟着他]

entries.source: Get ready!
entries.target: 做好准备！

entries.source: Defeat all three enemies!
entries.target: 击败全部三名敌人！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The Cornac rogue comes back from the shadows*#WHITE#
Well done, @playerdescriptor.race@! I knew you had potential.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The rogue takes off his hood, showing a fairly young, but unmistakably
#LIGHT_GREEN#battle-hardened man.#WHITE#
The name's Rej. I work for the arena to recruit great fighters who can give a
good show... and not die in two blows. You are one of those, indeed!
I won't keep you away from your adventures. I was there too, long ago.
But we can make you a true champion, beloved by many and bathing in diamonds.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*As you travel back to Derth in company of the rogue, you discuss your
#LIGHT_GREEN#battles in the forest. He provides you with great insight on your combat technique (#WHITE#+2 generic talent points#LIGHT_GREEN#)*
#WHITE#Very well, @playername@. I must go now.
Good luck in your adventures, and come visit us when you are done!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*那名科纳克盗贼从阴影中现身*#WHITE#
干得漂亮，@playerdescriptor.race@！我就知道你有潜力。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*盗贼摘下兜帽，露出一张颇为年轻、
#LIGHT_GREEN#却显然久经战阵的男人面孔。#WHITE#
我叫瑞吉。我为竞技场招募优秀斗士：他们既要能奉上精彩表演……也不能挨两下就死。你的确就是这种人！
我不会耽误你继续冒险。很久以前，我也曾踏上冒险之路。
但我们能把你培养成真正的冠军，让你受万众爱戴、坐拥无数钻石。

#LIGHT_GREEN#*你与盗贼结伴返回德斯镇，途中谈起自己在森林里的战斗。
#LIGHT_GREEN#他对你的战斗技巧提出了精辟见解（#WHITE#+2 通用技能点#LIGHT_GREEN#）*
#WHITE#好了，@playername@。我现在该走了。
祝你冒险顺利，等冒险结束后记得来找我们！

entries.source: I will. Farewell for now.
entries.target: 我会的。暂且别过。

entries.source: exit to Derth
entries.target: 通向德斯镇的出口

entries.source: Select the party member to receive the +2 generic talent points:
entries.target: 选择一名队伍成员获得 +2 通用技能点：

entries.source: #WHITE#I see. I will be waiting... #YELLOW#But not for long.
entries.target: #WHITE#我明白了。我会等你……#YELLOW#不过不会很久。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The Cornac rogue displays a welcoming smile*#WHITE#
Welcome back, @playerdescriptor.race@. Have you reconsidered my generous offer?
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*那名科纳克盗贼露出欢迎的微笑*#WHITE#
欢迎回来，@playerdescriptor.race@。你重新考虑过我那慷慨的提议了吗？
